name: Christoffel
beschreibung:
Overview

The Aktivhotel Christoffel is a three-star hotel and is located in Niederau, a district of the municipality of Wildschönau in the heart of Tyrol. The accommodation is situated on the quiet edge of the village yet close to the centre, so that everything can be reached comfortably on foot. The rooms – single, double and family rooms – have a balcony and a bathroom with WC and shower; many rooms have been renovated recently and some offer a view of the ski slope. Guests can stay on a bed-and-breakfast or half-board basis. An extensive breakfast buffet with regional products such as yoghurt, cheese, fresh farm milk, sausage, jam, fresh fruit, various types of muesli, chocolate spread and juices is included for guests staying at the hotel. The hotel's own restaurant is currently open only to hotel guests; à-la-carte guests can also have breakfast. Dogs are welcome and stay free of charge; food must be brought by the guest.

History/Background

According to its own account, the house looks back on a "time-honoured tradition": it has enjoyed an excellent reputation for many years and is now under new management. The operator is S.W. Verwaltungs GmbH, and the management lies with Toni Schagen. The business is assigned to the hotel industry division. Numerous rooms have been renovated step by step. Since summer 2025, the Aktivhotel has also been a partner of the Wildschönau Premium Card.

Getting there

The Wildschönau lies in the Tyrolean Lower Inn Valley and is accessible via the Inntal motorway (A12); the nearest railway station is in Wörgl. On site, the hotel is quietly located on the edge of Niederau yet connected to the village centre on foot. Guests benefit from the regional buses: with the Premium Card, the hiking bus within the Wildschönau can be used free of charge in summer, while in winter the ski bus and night bus are available with the Wildschönau Card.

Tips

As a partner of the Wildschönau Premium Card, its cost is included in the overnight price. The card includes, among other things, daily use of the summer mountain lifts Markbachjochbahn and Schatzbergbahn, the outdoor pool, the tennis court, the "z'Bach" mountain farm museum and the Augustinian Museum, as well as guided hikes and bike tours; it is valid during the season of the Wildschönauer Bergbahnen lifts. The hiking area reaches up to 2,300 metres and can be reached with the modern eight-seater gondola up to the Markbachjoch (Niederau) and with the longest gondola lift in Austria up to the Schatzberg (Auffach). In summer there are half-board packages, such as five nights from 390 euros per person or seven nights from 525 euros per person including breakfast buffet, three-course evening menu, one barbecue evening, a carriage ride and the Premium WildschönauCard; children up to five years stay free, from 6 to 13 years at a 50 percent reduction, and from 14 to 15 years at a 30 percent reduction. In winter, winter sports enthusiasts can expect around 55 kilometres of slopes, 26 lifts, a Race-'n-Boarder Park and night skiing, plus cross-country skiing and winter hikes.

Best time to travel

The Premium Card is valid exclusively during the season of the Wildschönauer Bergbahnen lifts from 10 May to 19 October. For winter sports, the cold season with the family ski area and the services of the Wildschönau Card – ski bus, night bus, guided hikes, snowshoe hikes and snowshoe rental – is the right time. Those seeking quiet relaxation and hiking should choose the summer months during the mountain lift operating season.
